# couchbase-capella_replications (Data Source)

The data source to list the XDCR replications of a cluster, or of all the clusters in a project when cluster_id is not set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lists the replications that start on one cluster.
data "couchbase-capella_replications" "cluster_replications" {
  organization_id = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  project_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  cluster_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
}

# Lists the replications of all the clusters in the project. A twoWay replication shows as two entries.
data "couchbase-capella_replications" "project_replications" {
  organization_id = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  project_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
}

output "cluster_replications" {
  value = data.couchbase-capella_replications.cluster_replications
}

output "project_replications" {
  value = data.couchbase-capella_replications.project_replications
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) - The replications, sorted by ID. Each direction of a replication is one entry, and only the cluster where it starts lists it. Thus, without cluster_id, a `twoWay` replication shows as two entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--audit))
- `direction` (String) - Direction specifies the replication flow — whether it's oneWay (source to target only) or twoWay (also from target back to source).
 - **Valid Values**: `oneWay`, `twoWay`
 - **Default**: `oneWay`
- `id` (String) - The ID of the specified replication.
- `source_cluster` (String) - The name of the source cluster.
- `status` (String) - The status of the replication.
 - **Valid Values**: `pending`, `pausing`, `failed`, `paused`, `running`
- `target_cluster` (String) - The name of the target cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--data--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.audit`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) - The RFC3339 timestamp associated with when the replication was initially created.
 - **Format**: Date-time in RFC3339 format
- `created_by` (String) - The user who created the replication; this will be a UUID4 ID for standard users and will be a string such as "internal-support" for internal Couchbase support users.
